summary: This document outlines a comprehensive Western Balkans travel itinerary for May and June 2026. It compares two transport options: a driving route starting from Finland and a bus-based route. Key stops include Belgrade, Sarajevo, Dubrovnik, Kotor, and Tirana, featuring specific dates, logistics, and accommodation recommendations for Shköder, Albania.
